evidence.title: Digital Edge Tops Out CGK1 and Secures Indonesia's Largest Single-Campus Power Deal with PLN
evidence.excerpt: Digital Edge reports the structural topping out of CGK1, the first building at its planned 500 MW IT CGK Campus in Bekasi, and forecasts CGK1 ready for service in Q4 2026.
